IC1: Richter's syndrome [OR], Burkitt's lymphoma [OR], or Burkitt-like Lymphoma [OR] (transformed DLBCL [OR] from Follicular NHL are eligible).
IC2: Prior transplant [OR] with stem cell infusion 90 days or active graft-versus-host treatment within 8 weeks of Day 1.
IC4: Chronic treatment with strong CYP3A4 [OR] inhibitor [OR]/ inducer, acid reducing agent [OR], Proton pump inhibitors
IC5: Known lymphomatous involvement of the CNS.
IC6: Persistent, unresolved NCI CTCAE v4.0 ≥ Grade 2, previous drug-related toxicity ([NOT] except alopecia [OR], erectile impotence [OR], hot flashes [OR], libido [OR], neuropathy).
IC7: Prior monoclonal antibody, radioimmunoconjugate, antibody drug conjugate, phototherapy, radiotherapy, chemotherapy, immunotherapy, immunosuppressive therapy, or any test agent within 3 weeks [OR] or for alemtuzumab 8 weeks of Day 1.
IC8: For CTCL: (TSEBT) within 12 weeks, or initiation of topical steroid [OR], nitrogen mustard [OR], or topical retinoid within 2 weeks. (Stable topical ≥ 4 weeks prior to Day 1 allowed).
IC9: Known carrier or infection for HIV [OR]/Hep [OR] B or C [OR]. HCV ab+ [OR] must be PCR-. HBV ab+ must be HBsAg- or undetectable DNA
IC11: Significant GI disease, previous major gastric [OR]/bowel surgery [AND], difficulty swallowing [OR] or malabsorption syndrome.
IC13: Previous malignancies within 2 yrs. unless relapse risk is small (< 5%).
IC14: Current use of systemic steroids >20 mg QD prednisone (or equivalent)
IC15: Breastfeeding [OR] or pregnant (intention to become) females or participation in other clinical trials
